body:
The parent issue with description is #2690

Proposed level changes for requirement in chapter "V13 API and Web Service"

Full list of requirements for the chapter is listed here: https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x21-V13-API.md

| # | Description | Level change |
| :---: | :--- | :---: |
| **13.5.2** | [ADDED] Verify that, during the initial HTTP WebSocket handshake, the Origin header field is checked against a list of origins allowed for the application. | 1 > 2 |
| **13.5.3** | [ADDED] Verify that, if the application's standard session management cannot be used, dedicated tokens are being used for this which comply with the relevant Session Management security requirements. | 1 > 2 |
| **13.5.4** | [ADDED] Verify that dedicated WebSocket session management tokens are initially obtained or validated through the previously authenticated HTTPS session when transitioning an existing HTTPS session to a WebSocket channel. | 1 > 2 |
| **13.6.1** | [ADDED, SPLIT FROM 14.5.1] Verify that only HTTP methods that are explicitly supported by the application or its API (including OPTIONS during preflight requests) can be used and that unused methods are blocked. | 1 > 3 |
| **13.7.1** | [ADDED] Verify that the value in the Content-Length request header field matches the calculated length using the built-in mechanism. | 1 > 3 |
| **13.7.2** | [ADDED] Verify that all Transfer-Encoding header fields are stripped from the message or that the request is blocked entirely. | 1 > 3 |
| **13.7.3** | [ADDED] Verify that a full CRLF (\r\n) sequence is neutralized inside a HTTP/2 header. | 1 > 3 |

The wording for 13.7.1, 13.7.2 and 13.7.3 is under discussion in https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/1154


Updates compared to initial proposal: requirement 13.4.2 is removed and 13.5.1 level decided to keep L1.

| # | Description | Level change |
| :---: | :--- | :---: |
| **~~13.4.2~~** | ~~[MODIFIED] Verify that authorization logic is implemented at the business logic layer instead of the GraphQL or resolver layer.~~ | ~~2 > 3~~ |
| **13.5.1** | [ADDED] Verify that WebSocket over TLS (WSS) is used for all WebSocket connections. | ~~1 > 2~~ |

comments.body:
> 13.5.1 [ADDED] Verify that WebSocket over TLS (WSS) is used for all WebSocket connections.

This is really the counterpart of "always use HTTPS". I don't like the idea of saying "this is L2" very much.

> > 13.5.1 [ADDED] Verify that WebSocket over TLS (WSS) is used for all WebSocket connections.
> 
> This is really the counterpart of "always use HTTPS". I don't like the idea of saying "this is L2" very much.

Agree, L1 seems prudent and it's easy for a dev to get this right.

It does seems a little inconsistent to require TLS for regular HTTP but not WebSocket. I also think that WebSocket is more common than something like WebRTC so I could be persuaded of L1 here. What do you think @elarlang ?
Not sure it would be in "my first priority list", but maybe I just lack experience with WebSockets. If it is hard to justify or explain to be L2, then it can be L1.

So I left 13.5.1 out and PR rest of it in.

13.7.1, 13.7.2 and 13.7.3 - levels are updated, but the wordings are finetuned in #1154
